sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Tailwind setup lines
sections.what: Three lines that load Tailwind's base reset, component styles and utility styles.
sections.why: Likely reason: these are the standard lines that enable Tailwind.
sections.watch_out: Removing any of the three lines makes many class names stop working.

sections.name: body
sections.title: Base page font and margin
sections.what: Removes the default page margin and sets the font and text smoothing for the whole page.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives the app a consistent look across pages.
sections.watch_out: Changes here affect every page at once.

summary: Loads the Tailwind styling base and sets the page font and text smoothing.
purpose: The global style sheet for the whole frontend.
why: Likely reason: Tailwind needs these three lines to add its classes. The body rule gives every page the same font.
how: The three Tailwind lines add reset styles, component styles and utility classes. The body rule removes the default margin, sets a font list that prefers the system font, and smooths text rendering.
inputs: The Tailwind setup and the tailwind.config.js file.
outputs: Styles applied to every page of the app.
risks: Changing the body margin affects every page. If none of the listed fonts exist, the browser uses a generic sans-serif font.
debug: If styles are missing, check the Tailwind content paths and confirm main.tsx imports this file.
